title: ATR buffer 0.1 x ATR and widest stop 70 pts
question: The ATR buffer makes stops wider (fewer trades): does allowing 70-pt stops win the trades back?
notes: Method: one-pass 5-year backtest (matches the live-loop replay on 766/768 baseline trades) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included; compared with run screen_baseline.
